name: pie
description: Native PI coding agent chat and session UI for VSCode

pie.nodePath.description: Absolute path to the standalone Node.js executable used to run the PI backend.

pie.sdkPath.description: Absolute path to the installed PI SDK package directory, such as @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent.

pie.agentDir.description: Absolute path to the pi agent directory that contains settings.json and models.json. Forwarded to the backend as PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR. Validated on startup: if this path no longer exists or lacks settings.json, the PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR env var and the extension's parent directory are tried as fallbacks (a warning is shown). If empty, the environment variable PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR is used as a fallback.

pie.experimentAssignment.description: Optional experiment/treatment assignment label recorded on new run analytics snapshots.

pie.allowInTreeAuth.description: Allow loading auth credentials from inside a Git working tree.

pie.useProxy.description: Start the local LiteLLM proxy (pie/proxy/) on activation and route API-key providers (umans + future) through it for concurrency limiting. GitHub Copilot and Ollama stay direct. When true, the extension health-checks the proxy on startup and fails loud (notice shown) if it can't boot — umans will be unavailable until fixed. Set false to bypass the proxy entirely (providers route direct, no concurrency limit).

pie.proxyPort.description: Port for the local LiteLLM proxy spawned by pie.useProxy. Must match the port models.json bases umans on.

enumDescriptions: Very verbose: include every log call site. High volume.
Verbose: include stream-telemetry snapshots and other diagnostic detail.
pie.logLevel.description: Minimum verbosity for pie's host-side logger (the `pie` OutputChannel, the persistent log file in the OS temp dir, and the extension-host console). Raising this surfaces existing debug/trace instrumentation (e.g. stream-telemetry snapshots) without restarting. Can also be changed live via the `pie: Set Log Level` command.
